ops_model.of_the_mass_min_20_move_heavy_: of the mass (min. 20 %) — move heavy packages to the front wall.
ops_model.pal_separate_carriage_contract: pal. — separate carriage contract, TTN and ESF for the service; do not mix pallets with KDL goods.
ops_model.go_no_go_release_required_tab_: Go/No-Go release required (tab "Documents KZ" or the load card)
ops_load.handed_to_a_partner_not_part_of: Handed to a partner — not part of the own vehicle load
ops_load.2_8_c_chamber_at_the_front_wall: 2–8 °C chamber — at the front wall so temperature is not lost when the rear door opens.
ops_load.lifo_loading_the_last_stop_is_l: LIFO loading: the last stop is loaded first, at the front wall; the first stop stands at the rear door. Numbers — unloading stop, ×2 — double-stacked, ↑ — taller than the chamber.
ops_load.days_at_delivery_short_expiry_a: days at delivery — short expiry, agree with branch
ops_load.no_restrictions_the_load_fits_s: No restrictions: the load fits, shelf life and places match.
ops_load.stack_height_two_pallets_on_top: Stack height (two pallets on top of each other — line in the middle), dashed — internal height
ops_load.no_catalogue_type_fits_split_th: No catalogue type fits — split the load or hand it to a partner.
ops_load.approximate_planning_values_eur: Approximate planning values (EUR pallets 1200×800) — not manufacturer data; replace with the registration and weighing data of the actual vehicle.
ops_load.splitting_does_not_fit_either_h: Splitting does not fit either — hand to a partner or postpone orders.
ops_load.how_it_decides_for_every_candid: How it decides: for every candidate it computes pallet places per temperature zone (LIFO — the last stop at the front wall, the 2–8 °C chamber at the front wall), weight, volume, front and rear axle load by the lever rule, gross mass, height of goods vs. internal height, ADR (LQ, UN 1845), road limits on every leg on the travel day and availability (hub, other trip, workshop). Feasible candidates first, then cheaper (rate ₸/km × km or full cost), ties by higher utilisation. Overloads are always shown with the exact excess.
ops_load.lifo_the_first_row_stands_at_th: LIFO: the first row stands at the front wall (last unloading stop); positions: odd left, even right; tier 2 goes on the pallet of the same position. A scan is checked against the planned position.
ops_docs.demo_form_verify_forms_and_requ: Demo form; verify forms and requirements with a KZ lawyer and tax adviser.
ops_docs.control_s_failed_exception_only: control(s) failed. Exception only with a reason (permission trips:override_release), recorded in the audit log.
ops_docs.trip_on_the_road_the_release_wa: Trip on the road; the release was granted before departure
ops_docs.every_control_checks_data_vehic: Every control checks data (vehicle availability, documents, calibration, insurance, tax and inspection, driver licence and medical check, place reconciliation, load, roads), never a text flag. Without a release the load cannot move to In Transit.
ops_dispatch.express_leaves_only_with_th: Express leaves only with three signatures (CEO, analytics, procurement/logistics) before the cut-off; any rejection or a passed deadline turns it into a regular trip. Approved express gets a +35 % surcharge and high priority.
ops_dispatch.no_shortfall_capacity_cover: No shortfall: capacity covers the demand of all 7 days
ops_dispatch.baseline_from_data_loads_pe: baseline from data: loads per ETA day, vehicle calendar (service, busy), drivers (rest); scenarios are what-if on top
ops_trips.an_alarm_of_this_trip_or_vehic: An alarm of this trip or vehicle is required; register the incident first
ops_trips.reason_of_10_characters_no_per: Reason of 10+ characters, no personal data
ops_trips.go_no_go_failed_exception_only: Go/No-Go failed — exception only with permission trips:override_release
ops_trips.forecast_is_current_no_clearan: Forecast is current; no clearance needed
ops_trips.token_renewed_the_old_link_no_: Token renewed; the old link no longer works
driver_app.every_item_is_scanned_mismatc: Every item is scanned; mismatch → exception.
driver_app.photo_reason_deviation_in_qua: Photo + reason → deviation in Quality, dispatcher notified.
driver_app.accepted_with_scan_return_leg: Accepted with scan; return leg and Quality update.
driver_app.breakdown_opens_route_service: Breakdown opens route service contacts; delay updates the dispatcher ETA.
driver_app.each_instruction_is_acknowled: Each instruction is acknowledged; the receipt shows in the feed.
driver_app.defect_service_request_after_: Defect → service request after the trip; hours → Staff.
driver_app.without_network_events_queue_: Without network events queue and send once online.
rec_insurance.no_contract_yet_the_entry_: No contract yet: the entry is a planning value for premium and certificate. The value is verified under Settings → Reference data → Planned values.
rec_insurance.a_claim_is_opened_from_a_t: A claim is opened from a temperature deviation of an insured shipment (Proof of Delivery → Deviations & quality). Amount up to the declared value; description without personal data.
rec_admin.every_entry_carries_the_hash_o: Every entry carries the hash of the previous one (chain). The real platform uses an HMAC with a server key; this is a demo hash. No personal data is logged.
rec_admin.tax_code_e_invoice_for_every_t: Tax Code – e-invoice for every transport service
rec_admin.minfin_order_no_657_tax_code_a: MinFin Order No. 657, Tax Code art. 179 – duty of supplier/recipient
rec_admin.mid_order_no_546_suspended_by_: MID Order No. 546; suspended by Order No. 189 for trucks > 3.5 t
rec_admin.fine_import_per_vehicle_recove: Fine import per vehicle, recovery from the driver (FR-114)
rec_admin.prices_in_kzt_with_eur_usd_at_: Prices in KZT with EUR/USD at the rate (FR-152)
rec_admin.no_carrier_duty_found_medicine: No carrier duty found (medicines marking since 01.07.2024; devices pilot only)
rec_admin.customer_erp_slots_offers_book: Customer ERP: slots, offers, bookings, statuses; signed webhooks (LH-P2)
rec_admin.only_the_integration_service_h: Only the integration service has internet access; every other service runs in the closed network (LH-P1). No external AI, analytics, CDN or font services (LH-Q2). Messages of systems without an API are registered manually in the Inbox.
ops_track.public_page_no_login_no_person: Public page: no login, no personal data.
eco_costmodel.actuals_come_from_the_cost: Actuals come from the “Costs” tab (Standgeld from receiving, workshop requests, manual entries, external carrier orders). Entries:
eco_costmodel.actuals_actuals_register_f: Actuals — actuals register: fuel fills from the driver app (litres, price, odometer, receipt photo hash), closed workshop requests, incoming partner ESF, toll statements, fines paid by the company. Entries:
eco_costmodel.to_1_every_15_000_km_0_75_: TO-1 every 15,000 km (0.75 day), TO-2 every 45,000 km (1.5 days), Sunday is service day (I45/J51). “Downtime day” — leasing, insurance, tax and crew base pay; “trip replacement” — ring load at the LTL rate of 228 ₸/kg.
eco_costmodel.hours_km_70_km_h_15_for_lo: Hours = km / 70 km/h + 15 % for loading and receipt; limit 1,814 h per year per driver; 6-day week, Sunday off and service. More FTE than crew — red.
eco_costmodel.plan_howo_26_l_100_km_jac_: Plan: HOWO 26 l/100 km, JAC 17 l/100 km (I38), V01 + 2.5 l/100 km for the unit. Actuals from Wialon fuel level sensors (R125), simulated before launch. TO-1 every 15,000 km (0.75 day), TO-2 every 45,000 km (1.5 days), Sunday is service day (I45/J51). Deviation > 8 % yellow, > 15 % red.
eco_costmodel.deregister_a_vehicle_or_le: Deregister a vehicle (or let OGPO lapse) only if idle ≥ 3 months, not leased, and tax + OGPO savings exceed re-registration (≈ 3 MRP). Leased vehicles need lessor consent; comprehensive cover continues. West closed up to 2 months in winter → V02 idle: leasing continues, tax saving negligible — better redeploy to R1.
eco_costmodel.own_vehicle_fuel_service_m: Own vehicle = fuel, service, mileage pay and per diem plus the vehicle’s fixed cost for the trip days. If the gap exceeds 50 %, two people of different functions approve: head of logistics and financial controller (FR-85). Signatures go stale when the diesel price changes; executing “external” creates order XO-n and an entry in the actuals register (FR-125). Switch the role in the top bar.
eco_reports.target_80_lower_by_weight_de: target ≥ 80 % · lower by weight (density 164 kg/m³, A4)
eco_reports.baseline_8_3_of_weight_36_3_: baseline 8.3 % of weight = 36.3 % of budget (A2) · target < 10 % of budget (T148)
eco_reports.idea_i_12_crossing_of_expres: Idea I-12: crossing of express and temperature shipments. Express 1,440 ₸/kg versus LTL 228 ₸/kg (G30). Moving express into the regular cycle delivers 78 % of the planned savings (G29); the report shows which part of express is cold chain (2–8 / −20 °C) and what moving each load yields. The per-load decision is a mock; the 3-signature express approval lives in Dispatch.
eco_reports.fines_are_the_driver_s_liabi: Fines are the driver’s liability (FR-07): the company pays (50 % discount within 7 days), requests a recharge in the driver app, deducts from payroll after acknowledgement (cap 50 % of base pay per period, Labour Code RK — article to verify) and exports the payroll sheet to 1C. Company payments land in the actuals register (FR-125).
eco_baseline.the_item_stays_open_until_e: The item stays open until every question to KDL is clarified; each clarification is written to the audit log.
eco_baseline.planned_values_that_drive_t: Planned values that drive the platform calculations, with a check status (FR-174). “Checked” is set by the financial controller or management; the entry goes to the audit log.
eco_baseline.23_cities_are_assigned_to_t: 23 cities are assigned to the Astana and Almaty hubs per answer P86 (FR-36); Karaganda and Atyrau are transshipment points instead of secondary warehouses (FR-37). Density 164 kg/m³ (A4); temp. = shipments per month at +2…+8 / +15…+25 / −20 °C. Makinsk: 1 temperature shipment per month, courier from Kokshetau (P92).
eco_baseline.target_fleet_h32_r111_r114_: Target fleet (H32, R111–R114): 4 vehicles of the 10-t class — the platform simulation and capacity plan run on this fleet (FR-38). 3.5 t ruled out. Delivery HOWO 35, JAC 30 working days; leasing: 30 % down, 16.5 %, 37 months (N74).
eco_baseline.question_catalogue_logistic: Question catalogue “Logistics Kazakhstan”: 150 answers from colleagues dated 07.10.2026, checked against the platform model. Sources — carrier waybills February–July 2026, the 2026 temperature shipment register, vehicle and leasing quotes. Codes in brackets are catalogue questions.
